BiblicalUsage: Mizra is a sown field, a planted strip of ground — here, the fields along the Nile that wither when Egypt is judged. What men planted with care dries up in a day when God withdraws His hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is a quiet warning: our plantings only stand while He waters them.
